activity.notes: Kumaragupta I Mahendraditya succeeded Chandragupta II around 414/415 CE and ruled the Gupta Empire until about 455. The succession boundary is approximate because the epigraphic record brackets the transition rather than preserving an exact accession day.

sources.title: Kumāragupta I — The Age of the Imperial Guptas
sources.citation_text: The historical study gives Kumāragupta I as 414–455 CE and explains from the Sanchi and Bilsad inscriptions that the sceptre probably changed hands about 414.

sources.title: Treasures of the Gupta Empire: Kumāragupta I
sources.citation_text: The numismatic study notes that exact accession is unconfirmed and that scholarly consensus places accession around 415 based on epigraphic evidence.
